author: blu
body: STALE. Nothing in the build runs this chapter, and build/cdx-to-pe.ps1 has been hand-edited ahead of it three times: the __syscall_handler lookup and the STAR/LSTAR/SFMASK programming (2026-07-27), the uefi-systab-addr store, and the AllocatePages repair plus the ram-size-addr store (2026-07-29). Emitting this chapter over that file reverts all three and the reverts are silent. Re-port before regenerating; the .ps1 is the authority until then.
